parse_benchmark_logs_from_directory: use LogParser.process to parse client, primary, and worker log files from a benchmark directory
generate_benchmark_summary: call result method on LogParser to generate a formatted summary of consensus and end-to-end throughput and latency
write_benchmark_results_to_file: call print method on LogParser to append the benchmark summary results to a file
parse_client_logs: use _parse_clients method to extract transaction size, rate, start time, and sample data from client log strings
parse_primary_logs: use _parse_primaries method to extract proposals, commits, config values, and IP from primary node log strings
